note: Missing `accessToken` — the Management Client's token is the evidence of the person's authority (HCP 6.1.9, 9.3).
`limit` above the carriage's ceiling of 1000 — a framework bound (question 3).
`limit` of zero — a page holds at least one event.
Unknown top-level request member — HCP 9.5 defines `cursor` and `limit`, not an offset, which would disclose the size of the log.
`nextCursor` null on the last page — the carriage leaves it out instead (question 3).
Missing `events` — every page carries the array, empty when nothing matches.
